set.body:
Follow-ups from the cold review of port slice 2 (d753a07d4). None blocking.
- F2: document that the Scala packet reads transcript.json (asr-transcript role) where the harness read segments.tsv; equal on this recording only.
- F3: Scala refuses inputs Python accepted (caption key " 3", duplicate JSON keys, quoted unit cells, duplicate header columns). Fail-closed; record in the design doc.
- F4: Row carries namesAll and namesAllCell (two coordinates, one meaning). Store the cell only and derive namesAll.
- F5: OUTLINE_COPY can write film/ASR text anywhere; refuse paths inside the work tree outside data/.
- F6b: check partition development/untouchedTest overlap in the CLI.
- F8: nearest-row test does not separate boundary from centre distance; no tie test between two non-containing rows.
- F9: no test for CLI development filter, hash-only output, non-finite transcript times.
- F10/F12: .get / map lookups in render and getResourceAsStream null become refusals (rule 12).
set.title: Slice 2 review follow-ups (FilmOutline/AgentPrompts hardening)
